Update since last:

## plot posteriors 
```{r}
#AT scores reported in the biomarker paper, drawn as a dashed line on the AT score plot
paper_at_scores <- tibble(patient = c(12, 20, 25, 78, 85),
                          AT_score = c(0.270, 0.495, 0.439, 0.552, 0.366),
                          ci_low   = c(0.259, 0.460, 0.410, 0.511, 0.353),
                          ci_high  = c(0.288, 0.546, 0.495, 0.666, 0.389))

#clauded up a function to plot posteriors versus priors
plot_prior_posterior <- function(patient_id, n = 4000, kappa = .2, filter_steady_state) {
  first_fit <- readRDS(make_fit_path(patient_id, here::here("fits/segmented_first_cycle")))
  full_fit  <- readRDS(make_fit_path(patient_id, here::here("fits/segmented_full_history")))
  
  prior_draws <- tibble(
    cost     = runif(n, 0, 1),
    turnover = runif(n, 0, 1),
    n0       = runif(n, 0, 1),
    rFrac    = runif(n, 0, 1),
    K        = rlnorm(n, log(2), .4),
    rS       = rlnorm(n, log(0.027), .05),
    sigma    = rlnorm(n, -2, 1)
  ) |>
    filter(K > n0) #stan bounds K below by n0
  
  params <- names(prior_draws)
  get_post <- function(fit) {
    fit$draws(params, format = "draws_df") |> as_tibble() |> select(all_of(params))
  }
  
  draws <- bind_rows(prior            = prior_draws,
                     `first cycle`    = get_post(first_fit),
                     `full history`   = get_post(full_fit),
                     .id = "dist") |>
    mutate(dist = factor(dist, c("prior", "first cycle", "full history")),
           #AT score from the same transforms as the stan model
           AT_score = calc_delta_benefit(kappa = kappa, dR = turnover * rS, K = K,
                                         rR = (1 - cost) * rS, R0 = rFrac * n0))
  
  #count posterior draws before and after filtering on eq. (8). The prior is left unfiltered
  n_before <- count(draws, dist, name = "before")
  if (filter_steady_state) draws <- filter(draws, dist == "prior" | turnover < (1-1.2*n0/K) * (1-cost) )
  n_after <- count(draws, dist, name = "after")
  draw_counts <- left_join(n_before, n_after, by = "dist") |> mutate(after = replace_na(after, 0L)) |>
    filter(dist != "prior")

  #number of divergent transitions in a fit
  n_div <- function(fit) sum(fit$diagnostic_summary(quiet = TRUE)$num_divergent)
  #largest rhat across the plotted parameters
  max_rhat <- function(fit) round(max(fit$summary(params, "rhat")$rhat, na.rm = TRUE), 3)

  fill_colours <- c("prior" = "grey70", "first cycle" = "#2a78d6", "full history" = "#eb6834")
  subtitle_text <- paste0(if (filter_steady_state) "Draws kept after steady state filter: " else "Draws: ",
                          paste(draw_counts$dist, paste(draw_counts$after, "of", draw_counts$before), collapse = ", "),
                          "\nDivergences: first cycle ", n_div(first_fit), ", full history ", n_div(full_fit),
                          "\nMax Rhat: first cycle ", max_rhat(first_fit), ", full history ", max_rhat(full_fit))

  #parameters
  params_plot <- draws |>
    select(-AT_score) |>
    pivot_longer(-dist, names_to = "parameter") |>
    ggplot(aes(value, fill = dist)) +
    geom_density(alpha = .5, colour = NA) +
    facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colours) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = paste("Prior and posteriors, patient", patient_id), subtitle = subtitle_text, fill = NULL)

  #AT score, with the paper's value as a dashed line. Non-finite scores and scores outside [-4, 4] are left out
  at_plot <- draws |>
    filter(between(AT_score, -4, 4)) |>
    ggplot(aes(AT_score, fill = dist)) +
    geom_density(alpha = .5, colour = NA) +
    geom_vline(data = filter(paper_at_scores, patient == patient_id), aes(xintercept = AT_score), linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colours) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2, 2)) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = paste("AT score, patient", patient_id),
         subtitle = subtitle_text)

  list(params = params_plot, at = at_plot, draws = draws)
}

#median and 95% interval of the AT score per patient and fit, filled in by the loop
at_summaries <- list()
for (id in c(12, 20, 25, 78, 85)) {
  #skip patients that are missing either fit
  has_fits <- file.exists(make_fit_path(id, here::here("fits/segmented_first_cycle")),
                          make_fit_path(id, here::here("fits/segmented_full_history")))
  if (!all(has_fits)) next

  plots <- plot_prior_posterior(id, filter_steady_state = T)
  print(plots$params)
  print(plots$at)

  #non-finite AT scores (log of a negative number) are left out of the summary
  at_summaries[[as.character(id)]] <- plots$draws |>
    filter(dist != "prior", is.finite(AT_score)) |>
    group_by(dist) |>
    median_qi(AT_score) |>
    mutate(patient = id)
}
```

## AT scores versus paper
```{r}
at_table <- bind_rows(at_summaries) |>
  select(patient, fit = dist, AT_score, .lower, .upper) |>
  left_join(paper_at_scores, by = "patient", suffix = c("", "_paper")) |>
  mutate(paper_in_interval = between(AT_score_paper, .lower, .upper))

knitr::kable(at_table, digits = 3)
```

Median AT score is above the paper's value in `r sum(at_table$AT_score > at_table$AT_score_paper)` of `r nrow(at_table)` fits. The paper's value is inside our 95% interval in `r sum(at_table$paper_in_interval)` of them. The full history fits sit closer to the paper than the first cycle fits for most patients.

## Freeing parameters one at a time, probing cycle
Step 0 is the probing cycle fit from biomarker_validation_r.Rmd: first cycle only, rS, rFrac, cost, dD and n0 fixed, turnover, K and sigma estimated. K has no upper bound and is bounded below by n0. Each step after that frees one more parameter and keeps the ones freed before it. The order goes from what the first cycle should identify most easily to least: n0 (first PSA measurement), dD (decline on treatment), rS (tight prior), cost and rFrac (resistance barely shows in the first cycle).

```{r}
probing_ids   <- c(12, 20, 25, 78, 85)
probing_fixed <- list(rS = 0.027, rFrac = 0.00001, cost = 0.1, dD = 1.5, n0 = 1)
free_order    <- c("n0", "rFrac","cost","dD", "rS" )

#fixed values for each step. Step 0 is the probing cycle fit, each step after frees one more parameter
steps <- map(0:length(free_order), \(i) probing_fixed[setdiff(names(probing_fixed), head(free_order, i))])
names(steps) <- c("0_probing", paste0(seq_along(free_order), "_free_", free_order))

#fits and their settings are saved per step. Saved fits are skipped, so this only fits what is missing
for (step in names(steps)) {
  fit_patients(probing_ids, stan_file = here::here("stan/model_switchable.stan"), priors = make_priors(),
               fixed_vals = steps[[step]], first_cycle = TRUE,
               out_dir = here::here("fits/probing_cycle", step),
               chains = 4, parallel_chains = 4, seed = 1, refresh = 500, adapt_delta = .95)
}
```

```{r results = "hide"}
#results hidden because generate_quantities prints cmdstan progress
params <- c("cost", "turnover", "n0", "rFrac", "K", "rS", "dD", "sigma")

#prior draws from a saved priors list. Fixed parameters take their fixed value and K is kept above n0 like in stan
draw_prior <- function(priors, fixed_vals, n = 4000) {
  tibble(
    cost     = runif(n, priors$cost_prior[1], priors$cost_prior[2]),
    turnover = runif(n, priors$turnover_prior[1], priors$turnover_prior[2]),
    n0       = runif(n, priors$n0_prior[1], priors$n0_prior[2]),
    rFrac    = runif(n, priors$rFrac_prior[1], priors$rFrac_prior[2]),
    K        = rlnorm(n, priors$K_prior[1], priors$K_prior[2]),
    rS       = rlnorm(n, priors$rS_prior[1], priors$rS_prior[2]),
    dD       = rlnorm(n, priors$dD_prior[1], priors$dD_prior[2]),
    sigma    = rlnorm(n, priors$sigma_prior[1], priors$sigma_prior[2])
  ) |>
    mutate(!!!fixed_vals) |>
    filter(K > n0)
}

#posterior draws, AT score, diagnostics and settings for the saved fits in a step
read_step <- function(step) {
  step_dir <- here::here("fits/probing_cycle", step)
  ids <- probing_ids[file.exists(make_fit_path(probing_ids, step_dir))] #missing means the fit failed
  if (!length(ids)) return(NULL)
  fits <- map(ids, \(id) readRDS(make_fit_path(id, step_dir)))

  draws <- map2_dfr(fits, ids, \(fit, id) fit$draws(params, format = "draws_df") |> as_tibble() |>
                      select(all_of(params)) |> mutate(patient = id)) |>
    mutate(AT_score     = calc_delta_benefit(kappa = .2, dR = turnover * rS, K = K, rR = (1 - cost) * rS, R0 = rFrac * n0),
           can_progress = progression_possible(cost, turnover, n0, K))

  diagnostics <- map2_dfr(fits, ids, \(fit, id) tibble(
    patient     = id,
    divergences = sum(fit$diagnostic_summary(quiet = TRUE)$num_divergent),
    max_rhat    = max(fit$summary(params, "rhat")$rhat, na.rm = TRUE))) #fixed parameters have no rhat

  settings <- readRDS(sub("\\.rds$", "_settings.rds", make_fit_path(ids[1], step_dir)))

  #predicted PSA over the full history from the first cycle posterior, next to all observed PSA
  mod <- cmdstan_model(settings$stan_file)
  trajectories <- map2_dfr(fits, ids, \(fit, id) {
    full_data <- make_stan_data(id, first_cycle = FALSE, settings$priors, settings$fixed_vals)
    patient_data <- load_bruchovsky_patient(id)
    mod$generate_quantities(fit, data = full_data, seed = 1)$draws("PSA_pred") |>
      summarise_draws(median, ~quantile2(.x, probs = c(.025, .25, .75, .975))) |>
      mutate(patient    = id,
             time       = full_data$output_times[full_data$obs_idx],
             PSA        = full_data$PSA_norm,
             cycle1_end = max(patient_data$Time[patient_data$CycleId == 1]))
  })

  list(draws = draws, diagnostics = diagnostics, trajectories = trajectories, settings = settings)
}

step_fits <- map(names(steps), read_step) |> set_names(names(steps))
```

```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
for (step in names(step_fits)) {
  step_fit <- step_fits[[step]]
  if (is.null(step_fit)) next
  fixed_vals <- step_fit$settings$fixed_vals
  free <- setdiff(params, names(fixed_vals))
  fixed_text <- if (length(fixed_vals)) paste(names(fixed_vals), unlist(fixed_vals), sep = " = ", collapse = ", ") else "none"

  #free parameters, prior in grey and one colour per patient
  prior_long <- draw_prior(step_fit$settings$priors, fixed_vals) |>
    select(all_of(free)) |>
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "parameter")
  params_plot <- step_fit$draws |>
    select(patient, all_of(free)) |>
    pivot_longer(-patient, names_to = "parameter") |>
    ggplot(aes(value)) +
    geom_density(data = prior_long, fill = "grey70", colour = NA) +
    geom_density(aes(fill = factor(patient)), alpha = .4, colour = NA) +
    facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "free") +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = paste("Prior (grey) and posteriors, step", step), subtitle = paste("Fixed:", fixed_text), fill = "patient")
  print(params_plot)

  #AT score on draws where progression is possible, with the paper's value as a dashed line
  at_plot <- step_fit$draws |>
    filter(can_progress, between(AT_score, -4, 4)) |>
    ggplot(aes(AT_score)) +
    geom_density(fill = "#2a78d6", alpha = .5, colour = NA) +
    geom_vline(data = paper_at_scores, aes(xintercept = AT_score), linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_wrap(~ patient, scales = "free_y") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1, 4)) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = paste("AT score, step", step), subtitle = paste("Fixed:", fixed_text))
  print(at_plot)

  #predicted PSA with 50% (dark) and 95% (light) intervals, observed PSA as points
  #dashed line is the end of the fitted first cycle, after it the model is predicting
  trajectory_plot <- step_fit$trajectories |>
    ggplot(aes(time)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q2.5, ymax = q97.5), fill = "#2a78d6", alpha = .2) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), fill = "#2a78d6", alpha = .4) +
    geom_line(aes(y = median), colour = "#2a78d6") +
    geom_point(aes(y = PSA)) +
    geom_vline(data = distinct(step_fit$trajectories, patient, cycle1_end), aes(xintercept = cycle1_end), linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_wrap(~ patient, scales = "free") +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = paste("Predicted and observed PSA, step", step), subtitle = paste("Fixed:", fixed_text),
         y = "PSA (normalised to first measurement)")
  print(trajectory_plot)
}
```

### Across steps
```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
#share of draws where progression is possible, next to the sampler diagnostics
step_diagnostics <- map_dfr(step_fits, \(x) x$diagnostics |>
                              left_join(x$draws |> group_by(patient) |> summarise(kept = mean(can_progress)), by = "patient"),
                            .id = "step")
knitr::kable(step_diagnostics, digits = 3)

at_steps <- map_dfr(step_fits, \(x) x$draws |>
                      filter(can_progress, is.finite(AT_score)) |>
                      group_by(patient) |>
                      median_qi(AT_score),
                    .id = "step") |>
  mutate(step = factor(step, rev(names(steps))))

ggplot(at_steps, aes(AT_score, step, xmin = .lower, xmax = .upper)) +
  geom_pointrange() +
  geom_vline(data = paper_at_scores, aes(xintercept = AT_score), linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ patient, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "AT score median and 95% interval per step", subtitle = "Dashed line is the paper's value", y = NULL)
```
